messages.subject: L5 and M10 calculation
parts:
Dear Vincent,

I would like to use the L5 and M10 metrics extracted with your package.
Is there a paper that describes how to calculate them?

Many thanks in advance,

Kind regards,
Sonia

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] L5 and M10 calculation
parts:
Hi Sonia,
Yes, there is a description in: Bradley AJ, Webb-Mitchell R, et al
Sleep and circadian rhythm disturbance in bipolar disorder.
Psychological Medicine 2017 Fenbruary, DOI: 10.1017/S0033291717000186
Further, you could of course dive into the code:
https://github.com/wadpac/GGIR/blob/master/R/g.getM5L5.R
Best regards, Vincent
